_how: Hand-maintained catalog for the current season. Before a storm, save the plan on planner.html (it lands in this browser's storage and storms.html offers it as a JSON row); paste the row here under "storms". After the storm, fill "actual" from the station, the Bridge Street gauge (NWPS SBSC1), USGS 11460000 and the PumpFuse app. Last winter's storms live in storms_2025_26.json, generated by analysis/export_models.py, and are not edited here. peak_10min_in is the heaviest 10 minutes (inches); sump_peak_inflow_gpm is pump seconds-per-15-min x 84 GPM / 900 if you want it, otherwise leave null.
